Current sharing emerges from local j_z=(V_d−V_s)/Ron,sp(T), with Ron,sp=1e-7 Ω m² (1 mΩ cm²) at 300 K and alpha=0.003/K. Ron,sp includes intrinsic channel/drift/contact contributions, so substrate electrical resistance is not counted again. A fixed-on gate assumption, not the insulated drawing, controls this load. The 10 A service includes finite localized feeds and one backside thermal path. No body diode, avalanche, switching or planar/trench distinction is modeled. All inputs are synthetic engineering assumptions at 300 K; thickness-averaged layers omit depth-resolved gradients. External feed loss is deposited 25% locally and 75% outside the model.

examples.notes:
A 1.8 × 1.6 mm three-metal alumina interposer routes 5 A around a protected central opening. Two parallel lower-metal arms transfer through hierarchical 4 × 4 via arrays into a middle-metal collector, then through a third array into the upper output landing. Local finite input/output feeds leave sheet resistance and via sharing observable. Compare the two branch transfers and individual via currents; bends and access resistance create local crowding. Synthetic SiO₂-equivalent intermetal gaps and a single alumina backside path represent package heat transfer. This is a DC interconnect example, not RF impedance, inductance, switching or a package qualification. All inputs are synthetic engineering assumptions at 300 K; thickness-averaged layers omit depth-resolved gradients. External feed loss is deposited 25% locally and 75% outside the model.
